acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Claiming, verifying, and optimizing your Google Business Profile costs nothing. Google charges only if you choose to run ads through Google Ads. The profile itself, including Posts, Q&A, reviews, and Insights, is free for every business.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for changes to show up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most edits appear within 24 to 48 hours. Verification by video takes a few business days; verification by postcard takes five to ten business days. Some changes (like a new primary category) may take up to a week for Google to process and reflect in local rankings.

mainEntity.name: Does my Google Business Profile affect my website's organic ranking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indirectly. GBP signals drive local pack rankings, which operate as a separate system from organic search results. A strong profile builds brand prominence online, which can help branded organic queries over time. But the direct impact is on the map pack, not on your website's position in the ten blue links.

mainEntity.name: How do I get more reviews without being pushy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask in person, right after a completed job, when satisfaction is highest. Send a follow-up text with a direct review link within the hour. The key is timing and ease: one tap, no hunting for your listing. Never offer discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews. Google's policies prohibit it, and customers sense it.

mainEntity.name: Can I rank in the map pack for cities where I don't have an office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you are a service-area business. Define your service area in your GBP settings and build a unique landing page for each city on your website. Proximity still matters: ranking in distant cities requires stronger prominence signals (reviews, links, authority) to overcome the distance disadvantage.
